options.content:
# Nic info on OPNsense routers
| Interface | Info | Notes |
| --------- | ----- | ----- |
| **ice0**  | SFP28 (25Gbit) | *Used in lagg0, link to switch2* |
| **ice1**  | SFP28 (25Gbit) | *Used in lagg0, link to switch1* |
| **ix0**   | RJ45 (10Gbit)  | *Used for WAN, link to upstream* |
| **ix1**   | RJ45 (10Gbit)  | *Used for INTER_CON, link to inter connect switch* |
| **igb0**  | RJ45 (1Gbit)   | *Used for PFSYNC, link to other router* |
| **igb1**  | RJ45 (1Gbit)   | *Not in use* |
| **igb2**  | RJ45 (1Gbit)   | *Not in use* |
| **igb3**  | RJ45 (1Gbit)   | *Not in use* |
| **lagg0** | Bond (20Gbit)  | *Using LACP, link to switches* |
| **lagg0_vlan99** | Tagged vlan 99 | *Used for LAN_NET_MGMT* |
| **lagg0_vlan500**| Tagged vlan 500| *Used for LAN_PROD* |
| **lagg0_vlan501**| Tagged vlan 501| *Used for LAN_ADMIN* |
| **ovpns1**| OpenVPN        | *Used for OOB Openvpn connection |
| **wg0**   | Wireguard      | *Used for site-to-site vpn* |
| **wg1**   | Wireguard      | *Used for ovh-to-site vpn*  |

spec.title: WAN In
spec.description:
Green = Below contract threshold
Yellow = Equal/Above contract threshold
Red = Equal/Above 8Gbit
Dark red = Maxing out link

spec.title: WAN Out
spec.description:
Green = Below contract threshold
Yellow = Equal/Above contract threshold
Red = Equal/Above 8Gbit
Dark red = Maxing out link
